fusions.name: Pocketful of Sparks
fusions.desc: Hurls a crackling handful that deals 26 damage, bursting to hit every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the damage. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Twitch Bolt
fusions.desc: A flicker of arcana that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Scramble the Weave
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Running Charge
fusions.desc: After you run a stretch, you restore 5 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
